scope: Standalone lossless GPU transfer codec: all 28 layers use our Dense or Rank256 predictor/rANS. The current single-feature rolling encoder and two-chunk binary-search decoder are the reference. Separate fixed decoder arms use packed coarse cutoffs with sparse 64-slot exceptions, or mask CDF loads for converged binary-search lanes. Original complete packets, fitted coefficients, probabilities, rANS state updates and BF16 words stay fixed. Packed inversion adds 45,568 shared device bytes; masked inversion adds none. SplitZip and ExANS remain separate unchanged controls, not candidate components. 512-token graph execution and 8K borrowed-input direct execution are retained. The two documents are reused engineering evidence, not independent generalization. Link costs are calculated, not NIC/SSD, resident P or serving measurements.
